annotations.text:
Editorial academic direction.

Newsreader (serif) for display and body copy, IBM Plex Sans for chrome and labels, IBM Plex Mono for figures. Warm paper ground, hairline rules, small-caps letterspaced labels.

Accent is a tweak — try the indigo, forest and oxblood swatches above the artboard.

The judged moment.

The rank deltas, the weight bars and the amber panel all say the same thing three ways, so a judge glancing at one screen can see the agent changed its mind.

Weight bars are new: they render numbers already in preference_summary, nothing invented.
